history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration reverify project expenditure, analyse the nature and amount of each expenditure settlement in detail and re-evaluate whether it meets the capitalization criteria to ensure that the project expenditure is accurately capitalized in the financial statements.
history.administration_response: The recommendation has been implemented. The Administration has verified the capitalizable value of the flexible workspace project on the basis of reviews of the purchase orders from the early stages of the project, charged under the legacy system, and records on the asset under construction from 2017–2020 using the existing work breakdown structure elements in the Umoja system, which included the closeout activities. The capitalizable value for the 2015–2016 period has been revised and the final value of the project has been accurately reflected in the 2021 financial statements. There are no open projects remaining in Umoja. The financial statements were transmitted to the auditors on 31 March 2022. The Administration requests the Board to close the recommendation.
history.board_assessment: Given that the Administration has revised the capitalizable value for the 2015–2016 period; that, according to paragraph 22 of the report of the Secretary- General on the implementation of flexible workspace at United Nations Headquarters (A/76/669) the capitalizable value for 2015 and 2016 is $8,056,602; and that the Board also reviewed the detailed breakdown of that amount, the Board considers this recommendation implemented.
